ValidationRule.description: ALF-LM-05 / ALF-LM-08. Extended 2026-08-14 to also block converting a Lead that was Disqualified immediately before this save (checked via PRIORVALUE, since Convert overwrites Status in the same DML).
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A Lead cannot be converted without a recorded Qualification Outcome, and a Disqualified Lead must be reactivated and re-qualified before it can be converted.
